title: The image isomorphism cancels with underived restriction
statement:
For any scheme morphism h, open W in its target, and module M on the source, the image-isomorphism component followed by the open direct image of the underived restriction-isomorphism component equals the underived open-composition component on the restriction of M. No cover, nonempty-open, or derived-category assumption is needed. Definitions: [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMVImageIso_composition_factor
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    (schemeMVImageIso h W).hom.app M ≫
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage W.ι.toLRSHom.toShHom).map
        ((schemeMVUnderivedOpenRestriction h W).hom.app M) =
    (schemeMVUnderivedOpenComposition h W).hom.app
      ((schemeOpenRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)).obj M)

proof.text: Expand the image isomorphism into associators and whiskered open-composition and inverse restriction isomorphisms. Equality induction identifies pushforwardCongr with eqToIso. All associator components are identities. Functoriality combines the final inverse restriction and restriction factors; their inverse-hom identity cancels them, leaving precisely the underived open-composition component.
